text: Engineered a zero-dependency Python library that dynamically detects input types (JSON, code, logs) and applies specialized compression, reducing LLM pipeline token usage by up to 90\%
Implemented recursive null-value removal for structured data, signature extraction with docstring and comment stripping for code, and log deduplication with error-only filtering
Benchmarked token efficiency across a 361-test suite using tiktoken, achieving a 76\% average reduction while maintaining a stateless, thread-safe, and non-mutating architecture
